title: Weirdo Breaks Into Ex-Girlfriend's House Then Goes OFF On Female Officer
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 9th, 2022. Officers were called to a home in Florida in regards to a man who was trying to break into his ex girlfriend’s home. When officers apprehended the man he became very rude and angry. He started berating the female officer by stating that he doesn’t think women should be cops. This is footage of the events that followed.
